{{Otheruses|Imperial research facility}}
The '''Imperial Research Center''' on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedesia]] was responsible for keeping the population under control by manufacturing [[FNA-23-B]], an inoculation that kept the [[Sedesian]]s "safe" from the [[FNV-23|Gray Death]]. Imperial [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Fesjo Negleem]] ran the facility, which had previously been a [[veterinarian]]'s.
